notes: Chat Styles performance update: decorative gradients are limited to the 50 most recent chat messages, color refreshes are batched, and Essentials no longer installs a global TextGet hook to reduce recursion risk in R133. Includes the v3.9.33 chat optimizations.

items: Limits public name gradients, whisper name gradients, whisper frame/background gradients, and Royal Seal gradients to the latest 50 native chat messages.
Older messages retain readable solid colors, names, symbols and non-gradient decorations.
Tracks the newest 50 chat rows without scanning the full log on every new message.
Low CPU mode disables decorative chat gradients while preserving solid colors.
Coalesces character chat color changes and processes refreshes in batches of up to 16 rows or 4 milliseconds per frame.
Keeps the v3.9.33 optimizations for unchanged-style caching, public and whisper refreshes, shared stylesheet batching and room cleanup.
Preserves delegated Quick Reaction event handlers and bounded inline-emote processing (maximum 40 rendered emotes per message).
Retains chat performance diagnostics and reports.
Removes Essentials' global TextGet hook to avoid participating in a previously observed recursion path.
Keeps wardrobe translation-cache repairs and targeted label fallbacks.
Compatibility and performance have passed local checks, but require verification in a live R133 session.
